evals.name: validates-registry-without-settings-edits
evals.expected_output: Reports the effective registry_dir with the layer scripts/registry-dir.mjs says supplied it (default, userConfig, team or local), the rendered skill_usage_dir and session_event_log_dir or their documented fallbacks, explains that the options are personal while registry_dir can also come from the repository's harness-ops.yaml, validates containment, reports the hook log root's guard state, and does not read or edit settings files or pluginConfigs.
expectations: Reads only the rendered user_config values and the registry-dir.mjs output
Reports every effective destination and containment status
Names the layer that supplied registry_dir
Explains personal versus repository-resident implications
Does not inspect or edit settings files or pluginConfigs

evals.name: routes-reconfiguration-through-claude
evals.prompt:
/harness-ops:setup

Keep the known-issues registry in this repository.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a portable project-relative path from repository evidence, names a committed registry_dir in <home>/harness-ops.yaml as the route that applies to everyone in the repository and the plugin option, set through Claude Code's plugin configuration, as the personal route, writes neither, and verifies the effective value and its layer on rerun before claiming success.
expectations: Uses repository-declared artifact conventions
Does not present a user option as tracked team policy
Names the team file as the repository-wide route and writes no file itself
Verifies the effective value and its layer on rerun

evals.name: rejects-uncontained-user-paths
evals.prompt:
/harness-ops:setup

My rendered registry_dir is ../shared and skill_usage_dir is C:\logs.
evals.expected_output: Rejects traversal, absolute, Windows drive, UNC, and escaping-symlink paths as invalid; does not join, normalize, create, or use either destination; and directs reconfiguration through Claude Code.
expectations: Rejects ../shared and C:\logs before any path join or write
Explains the project-containment boundary visibly
Does not silently fall back or claim to reconfigure the options

evals.name: apply-writes-only-the-guard
evals.prompt:
/harness-ops:setup apply

session_event_log_enabled renders true and session_event_log_dir is unset; this is a fresh git worktree and .observability/claude/ does not exist yet.
evals.expected_output: check reports the guard absent with logging on as FAIL, remediation apply. apply creates .observability/claude/.gitignore containing the single line `*`, announces that one path, then reads back the pair: `git check-ignore -v -- .observability/claude/.gitignore` names a rule and `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .observability/claude` fails. Nothing else is written: not the root .gitignore, not .git/info/exclude, not a session file, not any settings file. A second apply writes nothing and says already configured.
expectations: The only file written is <session_event_log_dir>/.gitignore with `*` as its first non-comment line
The root .gitignore, .git/info/exclude, settings files and pluginConfigs are never edited
The tracked-versus-ignored pair is probed and both results are reported as the readback
A re-run reports already configured and produces no diff

evals.name: refuses-a-root-equivalent-log-dir
evals.prompt:
/harness-ops:setup apply

My rendered session_event_log_dir is `.` and session_event_log_enabled is true.
evals.expected_output: check reports session_event_log_dir as FAIL, root-equivalent: a `*` guard at the project root would ignore the whole repository. apply writes nothing at all, repeats the FAIL with the reconfiguration guidance (set a contained subdirectory such as the default .observability/claude through Claude Code's plugin configuration), and does not normalize, join, or create the destination. The same refusal applies to a guard whose first non-comment line an operator changed away from `*`: apply reports it and never overwrites it.
expectations: A root-equivalent session_event_log_dir is FAIL and nothing is written
Routes the fix through Claude Code's plugin configuration, never a hand edit of settings
An operator-edited guard is reported, never overwritten
No file is created at or above the project root

evals.name: retirement-harness-ops-r001-migrates-the-old-hook-events-file
evals.prompt: /harness-ops:setup check, then apply, in a repo that still carries .claude/observability/hook-events.jsonl from before the hook log root moved to .observability/claude.
evals.expected_output: check runs bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/check-retirements.sh" --manifest "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/retirements.yaml" and reports the harness-ops-r001 TSV row as FAIL (action migrate: the sink and the observability skill read the new root, so the old file's rows are read by nothing) with apply as the remediation. apply appends the old file's lines to <session_event_log_dir>/hook-events.jsonl, shows the line counts before and after, waits for the operator's confirmation, and only then runs --clean harness-ops-r001 --i-migrated; a --clean without --i-migrated is refused (exit 2). A final re-run of detection reports the leftover gone. The skill-usage and OTEL stores under .claude/observability/ produce no finding.
expectations: check reports harness-ops-r001 as FAIL, not WARN or INFO
The old file's rows are appended to the new root's hook-events.jsonl before any clean
--clean harness-ops-r001 without --i-migrated refuses; the gated clean passes --i-migrated only after the operator confirms the migrated result
Detection is re-run last and the final state reported; the skill-usage and OTEL stores are not touched

evals.name: reports-whether-node-resolves-for-the-hook-launcher
evals.prompt: /harness-ops:setup check, on a host where `command -v node` finds nothing.
evals.expected_output: check probes `command -v node` through the Bash tool, not through a hook, and reports the Node.js row as FAIL: every hook row except `hook-failure-audit` starts through node, so those hooks do not launch and record nothing. The remediation is the person installing Node.js and starting a fresh session; the skill installs nothing.
expectations: The probe is `command -v node` run through the Bash tool
A missing node is FAIL with the consequence that no hook launches
Nothing is installed by the skill

evals.name: retirement-harness-ops-r002-migrates-the-morning-brief-team-settings
evals.prompt: /harness-ops:setup check, then apply, in a repo whose docs/conventions/harness-ops.yaml still holds the morning brief's Cost settings block and whose docs/conventions/work-items.yaml holds only ai_disclaimer: false.
evals.expected_output: check runs bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/check-retirements.sh" --manifest "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/retirements.yaml" and reports the harness-ops-r002 TSV row as FAIL (action migrate: /work-items:morning-brief reads its settings from work-items.yaml, so the block in harness-ops.yaml is read by nothing), with apply as the remediation. apply copies that block unchanged to the top level of docs/conventions/work-items.yaml, keeps ai_disclaimer: false, shows the operator the result and waits for their confirmation, and only then runs --clean harness-ops-r002 --i-migrated. A --clean without --i-migrated is refused (exit 2). A final run of detection reports the leftover gone.
expectations: check reports harness-ops-r002 as FAIL, not WARN or INFO
The Cost settings block lands in work-items.yaml, and its other keys stay, before any clean
--clean harness-ops-r002 without --i-migrated refuses; the gated clean passes --i-migrated only after the operator confirms the migrated result
Detection runs again last and the final state is reported

evals.name: retirement-harness-ops-r003-migrates-the-morning-brief-personal-settings
evals.prompt: /harness-ops:setup check, then apply, in a repo whose gitignored docs/conventions/harness-ops.local.yaml holds the morning brief's Cost settings block, which sets subscription, and that has no docs/conventions/work-items.local.yaml.
evals.expected_output: check reports the harness-ops-r003 TSV row from check-retirements.sh as FAIL (action migrate: the brief reads its personal layer from work-items.local.yaml), with apply as the remediation. apply creates docs/conventions/work-items.local.yaml holding that block unchanged, never copies the subscription into a tracked file, waits for the operator's confirmation, and only then runs --clean harness-ops-r003 --i-migrated. A --clean without --i-migrated is refused (exit 2). A final run of detection reports the leftover gone.
expectations: check reports harness-ops-r003 as FAIL, not WARN or INFO
The block moves to work-items.local.yaml, never to the tracked work-items.yaml
--clean harness-ops-r003 without --i-migrated refuses; the gated clean passes --i-migrated only after the operator confirms the migrated result
Detection runs again last and the final state is reported

evals.name: team-registry-dir-beats-the-option
evals.prompt:
/harness-ops:setup

This repository commits docs/conventions/harness-ops.yaml holding `registry_dir: tools/registry`, and my rendered registry_dir option is notes/registry.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/registry-dir.mjs and reports registry_dir as PASS from layer team, file docs/conventions/harness-ops.yaml, resolving to tools/registry under the project root, and says the team file beat the option value notes/registry. Writes nothing.
expectations: Resolves registry_dir through scripts/registry-dir.mjs rather than reading the option alone
Reports layer team and the file docs/conventions/harness-ops.yaml
Says the option value notes/registry did not win
Writes no file
